steps: Protect staff (PPE) and decontaminate (remove clothing, wash skin).
Secure airway; suction copious secretions — bronchorrhoea/respiratory failure is the killer.
ATROPINE in escalating/doubling doses titrated to drying of secretions and adequate oxygenation (not pupils/HR).
PRALIDOXIME (oxime) for organophosphates with nicotinic features/weakness.
Benzodiazepines for seizures; ICU monitoring (intermediate syndrome, rebound).

drugRefs.dose: start 1.8–3 mg IV, DOUBLE every ~5 min until chest clear/dry
drugRefs.freq: escalating/doubling boluses, then infusion to maintain atropinisation
drugRefs.why: The primary antidote. Titrate to drying of secretions and adequate oxygenation — NOT to pupils or heart rate. Large cumulative doses are often required.

drugRefs.dose: loading 30 mg/kg IV over 20 min, then 8 mg/kg/hour infusion
drugRefs.why: Reactivates acetylcholinesterase; give early for organophosphates with nicotinic features/weakness. Adjunct to — not a replacement for — atropine.
Controls seizures and reduces CNS toxicity/agitation.
